mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , t1.enc_acct_no AS encAcctNo , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , t1.fund_nm AS fundNm , t1.type_gb AS typeGb , t1.fst_seolj_ymd AS fstSeoljYmd , t1.sintak_gigan AS sintakGigan , t1.bf_gyul_ymd AS bfGyulYmd , t1.af_gyul_ymd AS afGyulYmd , t1.target_jasan AS targetJasan , t1.gyul_gi AS gyulGi , t1.haeji_gb AS haejiGb , t1.haeji_ymd AS haejiYmd , t1.re_seolj_year AS reSeoljYear , t1.re_seolj_aek AS reSeoljAek , t1.mg_cd AS mgCd , t1.re_seolj_ymd AS reSeoljYmd , t1.series_gb AS seriesGb , TO_DECRYPTS(t1.enc_acct_no) AS acctNo , se.gugan AS gugan FROM SZM0IA t1 , SZX0SE se WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, TO_DATE('2099-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) > #{ymd} AND se.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND se.series_gb = t1.series_gb ORDER BY t1.haeji_gb ASC, t1.mg_cd ASC, t1.fund_nm ASC, t1.re_seolj_ymd ASC

SELECT gu.s3_fymd AS s3Fymd , gu.s3_tymd AS s3Tymd , gu.s3_ilsu AS s3Ilsu , gu.m3_fymd AS m3Fymd , gu.m3_tymd AS m3Tymd , gu.m3_ilsu AS m3Ilsu , gu.g3b_fymd AS g3bFymd , gu.g3b_tymd AS g3bTymd , gu.g3b_ilsu AS g3bIlsu , gu.b3_fymd AS b3Fymd , gu.b3_tymd AS b3Tymd , gu.b3_ilsu AS b3Ilsu , gu.m3_gu AS m3Gu , gu.g3_gu AS g3Gu FROM TABLE(F_GUGAN(#{corpGr}, #{fundCd}, #{ymd})) gu
